in_game_description: A special kind of gas cloud plasma characterized by its red glimmer. It is very unstable and likely to explode if exposed to concussion. Can only be found deep in Vossk territory.
mechanics_text: Cannot be transported via Khador Drive without the 'Using Khador Drive To Transport Volatile Goods' glitch.
Available in all Vossk systems except V'ikka and Oom'bak (border systems); S'kolptorr (Risky) is the safest harvest point.
Most systems where it is found are ranked Dangerous — avoid fights and head for the jumpgate immediately on entry.
